resource: In-fight deadline of one runtime actor after the last hit dealt or taken
allocation_impact: One optional deadline per runtime actor, kept in the channel owner's attack state. Every hit dealt or taken moves it to 60 s after that hit and never earlier. While it runs a logout is refused and a closed client keeps the actor in the world, so an abandoned actor holds its runtime slot for at most 60 s after its last hit.
boundary_tests: max=60000: 59.999 s after the last hit the actor is still in fight, a logout is refused and a closed client keeps the actor in the world
max+1: at 60 s after the last hit the deadline has passed, the logout blocker lifts and an abandoned actor is released
consumers: apps/game-server/src/gameplay_transport/mod.rs hold_while_in_fight: release after grace and terminal release wait for the deadline
notes: ATTACK-0 §5 (manual §5.3.12.c) and ARCH-CORE-LOOP-PACKETS-2 §2.3. Canary's in-fight condition (CONDITION_INFIGHT, pzLocked ticks of config.lua.dist pzLocked = 60000) lasts 60 s after the last attack.
